idea-plugin.name: GPSR Listing Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Audits a product feed row by row against Article 19 of the EU General Product Safety Regulation

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → GPSR Listing Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 12 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/gpsr-listing-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/gpsr-listing-lint

action.text: GPSR Listing Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run GPSR Listing Lint on the file in the editor
